create_OutcomeSamplingSolver: create an OutcomeSamplingSolver instance for a sequential game to run Monte Carlo counterfactual regret minimization
run_OutcomeSamplingSolver_iteration: run one iteration of outcome sampling MCCFR for each player as the update player
build_OutcomeSamplingSolver_episode: build an episode of outcome sampling that traverses game states and updates regrets and average strategies
test_OutcomeSamplingSolver_baseline_corr: test the baseline-corrected child value estimation using counterfactual weighting
review_OutcomeSamplingSolver: review the OutcomeSamplingSolver class that implements outcome sampling MCCFR for sequential games
